name: sidar_warrior
description: a Sidar Warrior, a pale grey-skinned fighter with pale grey eyes: a ragged pale grey hooded cloak, a teal scarf at the throat, a dark grey tunic with a brown belt and a round silver buckle, grey cloth-wrapped legs and dark grey boots, a bone-white wooden club studded with round silver studs raised in his RIGHT hand, and a round black shield with a grey studded rim and a white crescent moon on his LEFT arm
hands: the studded club stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and the crescent-moon shield on his left arm on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the bone-white studded club is lifted beside the head with its heavy end pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the club hand behind the head and the studded club hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, the crescent-moon shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the club arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the studded club is level, its heavy end pointing to the right
strike.4: contact: club arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the studded club smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the crescent-moon shield swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the club carries on down until its studded end nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the hood and the ragged cloak trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the studded club comes back up on the near side toward its raised ready angle, the crescent-moon shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left inside the hood, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (club arm thrown up and out to the left, the crescent-moon shield flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the studded club dipping, the crescent-moon shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, club arm flung up, the crescent-moon shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the hooded head droops, the studded club lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the club's studded end resting on the ground at the lower-right, shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the studded club slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the hood still on his head; the studded club lies on the ground at the lower-right; the round crescent-moon shield lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the round shield rocks, the ragged cloak settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the studded club and the crescent-moon shield on the ground beside him
